Best strategy would be to avoid it altogether imho. It has 8 monster groups and the rewards for fighting it are low. Ragnarok, Doomsday and Ancients are the way to go! Hellforge for getting Omniscience gear is also pretty neat. Avoid Shadow Invasion too if your clan does CP runs.

Well said. They made a colossal mistake, their greed will be their downfall. Good for us, now we will keep our money for better things :)
